# Verify State

The verify function provides a shadow compilation mechanism that checks the current state of the repository against a full compile without writing changes. It identifies any divergences in entity and relationship structures, ensuring consistency in the knowledge produced.

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/run.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.run.verify`
